name: decisions_read

select.description: Which read to run. A field marked [select: ...] applies only to the selects named.

itemId.description: Only decisions about this item. Item id: UUID or 8-32 hex.

ancestorId.description: Only decisions about this item or one below it, and the item-less decisions of it as a root. Item id: UUID or 8-32 hex.

runId.description: Only decisions of this run. Run id: UUID or 8-32 hex.

rootId.description: Only decisions on this root. Item id: UUID or 8-32 hex.

decisionIds.description: Only these decisions: full UUIDs, at most 50; an unknown id is left out and [] matches nothing.

status.description: Only decisions in one of these statuses; absent means any.

waitingOn.description: Only pending decisions routed to this answerer.

severity.description: Only decisions of this effective severity.

overdue.description: true: only pending decisions past their expiry; false or absent: no filter.

includeContext.description: true: include each decision's context; default false.

cursor.description: The page.next value of the previous page.

describe.description: true: return each operation's parameters and errors; nothing runs.

seatToken.description: Run seat token; omit when not seated.

description: Read decisions, the questions raised for an answer. select: list (decisions, newest first, with the decision classes in force on their roots). A decision is outside the call scope when its root is. Call with describe:true for parameters and errors.
